map.sentence: This is Timmy — a terminal agent that writes a receipt for everything it does.
Every action is hashed, signed, and chained.

map.sentence: Nothing gets deleted, and nothing gets rewritten.
Tonight, we put it to work on a card break.
Every box went into the record before the wrap ever came off — the ones we bought, and the one Fanatics sent us, with the letter on file.
By the time the first pack was opened, the proof already existed.
You don't have to trust any of it, because you can check all of it.
And when a bad record showed up, Timmy didn't argue — it refused.
Agents that can't lie about what they did.
